record

sections · 0.3.0 · aj-s-record

The Timeline's list (v4 C1): the sheet with its rows as the old design draws them (month headings, a day's writing with its lede and any mark, a recording with its player, its transcript row and its tools), and the jump's arrival drawn over it: the list scrolls to the day, waits for the scroll to end, a wash in each day's mood passes through its rows, and a frame is drawn round them (one round each run of neighbouring days) and held with each date in its mood colour. The jump takes one day (the card) or several (a reflection's entries).
